questions.question: Can you walk me through your experience verifying, posting, and reconciling detailed business transactions in the general ledger using the FASKB system at Graphic Packaging?
Describe your role in the month-end close process at Elior or Graphic Packaging, including the journal entries, reconciliations, and post-close analysis you performed.
What steps did you take to ensure that your accounting entries and financial reporting complied with GAAP across multiple cost centers or schools?
At Graphic Packaging, you prepared reports that summarized and forecast business activity and financial position. How did you develop those reports, and what data or assumptions did you use?
Please describe your experience reviewing balance-sheet account reconciliations, such as cash or demand-deposit accounts. How did you investigate and resolve discrepancies?
Tell me about your work reconciling sales and use tax balances with main account balances and supporting state business-license renewals. What controls did you use to ensure accuracy?

Describe the quarterly consolidation of intercompany reconciliations you prepared for partnership entities, loans, and accounts receivable balances. How did you validate the information before providing it to external auditors?
What was your role in audit support and audit walkthroughs with internal auditors and EY, and how did you organize supporting documentation?
You have experience maintaining investment and subsidiary ledgers, amortization schedules, and interest accruals. How did you reconcile those subsidiary records to the general ledger?

This remote contract role may require assisting lower-level accountants while managing deadlines independently. How have you coordinated with field personnel, tax teams, controllers, or other stakeholders to resolve accounting issues and keep work on schedule?
